headline_en: Typhoon bands approach the Yangtze Delta
body_zh: 强风迫使港区和浦东机场分批限流，电子元件与机械备件补库成本上升。部分进出港航班取消，剩余座位价格走高。
body_en: Strong winds are throttling port and airport capacity. Electronics and machinery replenishment costs rise while some flights are removed.

headline_zh: 沙尘暴压低迪拜机场能见度
headline_en: Sandstorm cuts visibility at Dubai International
body_zh: 低能见度造成跑道间歇关闭，自由区仓储周转放缓。能源、矿产与高价值工艺品的现货报价同步上扬。
body_en: Low visibility intermittently closes runways and slows free-zone warehouses, lifting spot quotes for energy, minerals, and crafts.

headline_zh: 英镑急波动，海关加强抽检
headline_en: Sterling swings as customs inspections tighten
body_zh: 汇率波动吸引海外买家抢购茶叶与手工艺品，但边检加严挤压航空货运舱位，伦敦航线票价小幅上涨。
body_en: Currency swings boost overseas demand for tea and crafts while tighter inspections squeeze air-cargo capacity.

headline_zh: 关东台风打乱精密制造供应链
headline_en: Kanto typhoon disrupts precision supply chains
body_zh: 湾岸工厂暂停出货，传感器与机械零件短缺。羽田进出港时刻大面积收紧，电子与机械商品价格上扬。
body_en: Bay-area factories pause shipments, tightening sensor and machinery supply as Haneda reduces movements.

headline_zh: 樟宜国际贸易展客流激增
headline_en: Trade expo sends Changi demand surging
body_zh: 自由港展会吸引区域采购商，电子、机械和工艺品买家集中入场。航空需求旺盛，商品售价与客票同步走高。
body_en: A free-port trade expo brings regional buyers for electronics, machinery, and crafts, lifting both sale prices and airfares.

headline_zh: 季风积水阻断曼谷城内物流
body_zh: 低洼道路积水拖慢食品和纺织品入城，机场地面保障也受雷暴影响。现货紧张，部分航班被削减。
body_en: Flooded roads slow food and textile deliveries while thunderstorms constrain airport ground operations.

headline_zh: 迈阿密发布飓风观察预警
body_zh: 居民集中采购食品与咖啡，迈阿密机场开始压缩航班计划。必需品需求跳升，离港座位快速减少。
body_en: Residents stock up on food and coffee while Miami International cuts its schedule and outbound seats disappear.

headline_zh: 欧亚贸易走廊启用临时通关优惠
headline_en: Temporary customs relief opens on the Eurasian corridor
body_zh: 纺织与工艺品出口手续简化，本地采购价下探、海外买盘增强；新增商务客流让伊斯坦布尔航线略显紧张。
body_en: Simplified textile and craft export rules lower sourcing costs and strengthen demand, while business travel tightens flights.

headline_zh: 鲜花拍卖与地勤工会同步短停
headline_en: Flower-auction and ground crews stage a short stoppage
body_zh: 拍卖场与机场地勤短暂停工令鲜花、食品等时效商品供应收紧，史基浦部分班次被合并。
body_en: Short labor stoppages tighten time-sensitive flower and food supply and force Schiphol to consolidate flights.

headline_zh: 落基山暴雪撞上户外用品展
headline_en: Rockies snowstorm collides with outdoor expo
body_zh: 滑雪季展会推高食品与工艺纪念品需求，但除冰作业拖慢丹佛机场周转，剩余航班价格上涨。
body_en: A ski-season expo lifts food and craft demand while de-icing slows Denver operations and raises remaining fares.
